question: Which river basin covers an area of 8,60,000 km² and is spread across 11 Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ganga Basin__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Ganga Basin, is also known as the Ganges- Brahmaputra- Meghna River Basin. 
 
• It is among the northern most flowing in the eastern direction.
 
• It has many tributaries **Gomti, Ghandhak, Kosi, Ghaghra **etc.
 
• This river flows from the Himalayas to the southern and eastern direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Mahanadi Basin,__ is the major river of the central eastern indian. This basin also have a dam built on it. which is Hirakund Dam. Mahanadi flows through Chhattisgarh and Orissa, having the tributaries as hasdo, mand, onk, jonk , tel etc.
 
• __Indus basin,__ is one among the largest river basin in india. It flows from BoKhar Chu Glacier to the western direction. between Zaskar and the Great Himalayas.
 
• This river has the length of 3180 km. 
 
• __Brahmaputra river ,__is also known as Tsangpo Tibet, this river basin flows in the eastern most direction in the states of Arunanchal Pradesh and Assam moving towards the southern direction. Brahmaputra have many left-right tributaries as lohit, subanshiri, teesta, dibang, dihang etc.
